scientific.integrity: The period-two family is obtained by solving the exact Signum recurrence under the only possible nontrivial two-step sign itinerary. Normal attraction is proved by an exact two-step affine return map, whose tangential and transverse multipliers are one and the square of the momentum parameter.
limitations: Only deterministic one-dimensional positive quadratics with constant learning rate are covered.
The result classifies nontrivial period-two orbits and their local normal behavior, not all global or higher-period dynamics.
The local attraction statement requires persistence of the alternating momentum-sign itinerary.
Stochastic gradients, schedules, weight decay, and other sign conventions are outside scope.

title: Exact continuum of neutral two-cycles for scalar Signum
